services.name: Work Horse Award
services.desc: We are pleased to announce the winners of the 2020 Work Horse Award - Joyce and Jay Martin! Usually announced at the Christmas Party, the Bud Nation Work Horse Award is given to the member or members who go above and beyond in supporting the club. Joyce serves as Treasurer and has been instrumental in the success of multiple events, including the AHCA Obstacle Competitions and horse shows. She and Jay have put in countless hours volunteering at events and helping maintain the club's facilities and grounds. They are avid trail riders and can be found participating and helping at the DCTR rides. We appreciate all their contributions and are pleased to award them the 2020 DCTR Bud Nation Work
